html:
The Gunggari are an Aboriginal people of southern Queensland, whose country centres on the Maranoa River around present day Mitchell.

Their land overlaps with that of several neighbours, among them the Mandandanji, Kooma, Kunja and Margany peoples, as well as the Nguri and Wadjalang. They should not be confused with the Kuungkari further north. The explorer Thomas Mitchell passed through in 1846, and pastoral runs followed in the 1850s and 1860s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Gunggari are an Aboriginal people of southern Queensland, whose country centres on the Maranoa River around present day Mitchell.
